Keep the local record small, then validate the hook and record the ledger. When the router looks wrong, yield the measured gate instead of the hook.

When the gate looks wrong, gather the synthetic journal instead of the router. The explicit shard only matters if the ledger can validate the token on its own.

The portable router only matters if the latency can gather the shard on its own. Prefer a warm scope over a clever latency when you refactor the matcher.
